name: nonApi_updateTrackImport
description: The track-import processor's progress write (E5.F5.S7): after each slice of activities, and on completion or failure. A NULL parameter leaves its column as it is (ISNULL(@x, column)); @status is always written. Status 1 (processing) stamps StartedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME(); 2 (done) and 3 (failed) stamp ProcessedAt. Called by the API's ProcessTrackImport function and the nightly backstop; internal, no auth. Returns nothing; a runtime error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown. HC.TrackImport is not a synced table, so nothing re-syncs.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: 0 queued, 1 processing, 2 done, 3 failed. Always written.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The file kind the processor detected (0 unknown until read). NULL keeps.

parameters.name: nextIndex
parameters.description: Index of the next activity to process — the resume point for the next slice. NULL keeps. Column is NOT NULL with default 0.

parameters.name: activityCount
parameters.description: Activities found in the file. NULL keeps.

parameters.name: importedCount
parameters.description: Activities imported as tracks. NULL keeps.

parameters.name: skippedCount
parameters.description: Activities skipped (no matching run, duplicate…). NULL keeps.

parameters.name: heldCount
parameters.description: Activities held for the hasher to resolve. NULL keeps.

parameters.name: resultJson
parameters.description: Per-activity outcome JSON shown to the hasher. NULL keeps.

parameters.name: errorMessage
parameters.description: Why the import failed (status 3). NULL keeps. Matches the column (NVARCHAR(2500)).

sideEffects: UPDATE one HC.TrackImport row (Status, Kind, NextIndex, ActivityCount, ImportedCount, SkippedCount, HeldCount, ResultJson, ErrorMessage, StartedAt, ProcessedAt).
On any runtime error: rolls back if a transaction is open, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<unknown>'), then THROWs.

codeSmells.detail: @id, @status have no SQL default. Called only by the API's import processor, which always passes both. A call that omits one fails before the body runs — no HC.ErrorLog row, no graceful check (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default').

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
